subject: structured Homebrew postflight publication
statement: Published Gograph Homebrew casks contain exactly one structured postflight_steps stanza and no deprecated postflight stanza. While the configured GoReleaser version emits the legacy hook form, release publication must transform only the exact known legacy stanza (or accept the exact structured stanza unchanged), fail closed on missing, duplicate, or conflicting forms, preserve macOS quarantine removal, and validate the final tap artifact.

evidence.scope: Fail-closed generated-cask rewrite and current structured tap syntax

origin.reference: gograph working tree and local Homebrew installation

evidence.locator: cmd/mcpb-release/homebrew_cask_test.go; cmd/mcpb-release/makefile_contract_test.go; Makefile verify; brew style Cask/InstallSteps; brew doctor
evidence.scope: Missing, duplicate, conflicting, idempotent, workflow-contract, full-gate, Homebrew parsing, and doctor regression verification
